A '''T3 web comber'''<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> was a [[Color/Legends|silver]]-colored, concial device with a long tube coming out of the top. The [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], had a T3 web comber on the workbench in [[Gender/Legends|his]] bedroom. He used the workbench for building the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and the comber sat next to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] when Skywalker showed his creation off to [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which includes the appearance of the T3 web comber, to [[32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A T3 web comber first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The device was first named in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
